proof3.title: Designed Around Your Process
proof3.text: No forcing standard products onto the site

hero.contactTitle: Send us your drawings, site photos or requirements. We can start from there.

1.title: Too Much Manual Work
1.text: Repeated handling, sampling, inspection and data entry consume labor and introduce variation.

2.title: Disconnected Equipment
2.text: Robots, cameras, PLCs, instruments and software do not communicate, making maintenance difficult.

3.title: Poor Traceability
3.text: When something goes wrong, sample history, batch records, equipment states and actions are hard to recover.

4.title: Cross-Border Delivery Is Hard
4.text: Requirements, interfaces, acceptance and after-sales support become harder when teams work across locations and time zones.

solutions.title: What We Can Solve for You
solutions.desc: We do not sell a pile of buzzwords. We connect equipment, controls, vision and software around your production process into a system that works and can be maintained.

1.title: Robotic Automation
1.text: Machine tending, material handling, assembly, palletizing, laboratory operations and custom robotic cells.

2.title: Machine Vision & Inspection
2.text: Defect inspection, dimensional measurement, OCR, barcode reading, positioning and robot guidance.

3.title: Automated Sampling & Laboratory Automation
3.text: For coal, ore and bulk materials: connect sampling, preparation, transfer, testing and traceability.

4.title: Custom Equipment & Line Integration
4.text: Develop special-purpose equipment, tooling and controls for unique processes and connect them to existing lines.

5.title: Industrial Software & Data Platforms
5.text: Bring equipment status, production, quality, alarms and reports into one usable platform.

6.title: Intelligent Assistance & Workflow Automation
6.text: Connect knowledge, rules, business systems and intelligent tools into daily operations to reduce repetitive decisions and actions.

cases.title: Project Cases
cases.desc: Project needs and delivery approaches are presented by industry, scenario and overseas market. Customer names and sensitive information are not displayed publicly.

1.title: Automated Coal & Mineral Sampling System
1.text: For continuous material flow, unstable manual sampling and difficult sample tracking: automated sampling, crushing, dividing, sealing, transfer and identity management.

2.title: Robot Machine-Tending & In-Line Inspection Cell
2.text: For mixed-part production: combine robot loading, fixture changeover, vision inspection and machine-status collection in one cell.

3.title: Laboratory Robotic Automation
3.text: Automate sample transport, workstation tasks, instrument loading and result recording to reduce repetitive manual operations.

4.title: Flexible Robotic Workstation
4.text: For low-volume, high-mix production: use changeable tooling and recipe-based programs to shorten changeovers.

5.title: Conveyor & Robot Retrofit
5.text: Add robotics, inspection and controls while keeping existing equipment, reducing the scope and downtime of line modifications.

6.title: Production & Equipment Data Platform
6.text: Bring machine status, alarms, output and quality data together so operations and maintenance teams share one view of the plant.

7.title: Warehouse Handling & Vision Identification
7.text: Connect material identification, picking, transfer and location data to increase warehouse automation.

8.title: Remote Monitoring & Service Support
8.text: Create remote access to status, logs and alarms for overseas equipment to reduce troubleshooting and time-zone coordination costs.

reasons.title: Complex projects fail when every supplier only owns one small piece
reasons.desc: We are best suited to projects involving multiple devices, interfaces and processes. You do not need to coordinate separate robot, vision, software and controls vendors on your own.

1.title: One Team Owns the Whole System
1.text: From concept to site commissioning, interface problems stay with us instead of being pushed back to the customer.

2.title: Custom Engineering Is Normal for Us
2.text: We design equipment and software around the process instead of forcing the process to fit a product.

3.title: We Understand Both the Shop Floor and Software
3.text: Mechanical, electrical, controls, vision and software are designed as one system.

4.title: Ready for International Coordination
4.text: Support for cross-border requirement alignment, technical documentation, remote commissioning and after-sales coordination.

1.title: Requirements & Site Information
1.text: Drawings, videos, cycle time, products, interfaces, existing equipment and target outcomes.

2.title: Proposal & Quotation
2.text: Confirm scope, architecture, equipment selection, schedule, deliverables and acceptance criteria.

3.title: Design & Build
3.text: Mechanical, electrical, software, vision and controls progress in parallel.

4.title: FAT & Integration Test
4.text: Validate functions, abnormal conditions, cycle time and interfaces before shipment.

5.title: Site Delivery & Support
5.text: Installation, SAT, training, documentation, spare-parts recommendations and ongoing support.

process.title: How We Move a Project Forward
process.desc: We define scope and acceptance criteria before detailed design and development. This matters even more for international projects.

global.title: Engineered in Zhuhai for Projects Worldwide
global.desc: For overseas customers, we can start with remote requirement clarification, then complete engineering, design, manufacturing, testing and delivery preparation, followed by site installation, commissioning and ongoing support as required.

about.title: Zhuhai Xiaodu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
about.p1: We are an industrial technology company focused on robotics, machine vision, automation equipment, industrial software and system integration.
about.p2: We care less about selling one product and more about whether the project actually works: whether equipment connects, cycle time is achieved, abnormal conditions are handled, data is traceable and the system remains maintainable.
about.p3: If your project needs Chinese supply-chain resources, an engineering team and coordination with an overseas site, we can join from the early concept stage.

contact.desc: We first assess feasibility, approach and risk before moving into a formal proposal. The earlier real constraints are made clear, the faster the project moves.
